init_svd_volume: initialize the SVD volume for density and appearance plane and line coefficients with a given resolution and device
compute_densityfeature: compute density features from sampled 3D coordinates using plane and line basis grid sampling
compute_appfeature: compute appearance features from sampled 3D coordinates using plane line basis and a basis matrix
upsample_volume_grid: upsample the volume grid to a target resolution by interpolating plane and line coefficients
shrink: shrink the volume grid to a new axis-aligned bounding box by cropping plane and line coefficients
